jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. human_review.title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
human_review.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Where you'll leave your mark?: Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign. Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps. Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps. Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality. Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps. Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches. Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make. Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting. Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work. The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects. Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool. A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs. Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. Good to Have Basic SQL and familiarity with APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience with GA4, enrichment or intent tools. Experience evaluating, rolling out and managing a MarTech or GTM tool. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

human_review.description: Accountabilities: Monitor data quality and observability across foundational data assets and business-ready data products, reviewing alerts related to completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, uniqueness, freshness, and unexpected data patterns. Investigate anomalies and reported defects using SQL, data profiling, metadata, lineage, and observability evidence. Trace issues across source systems, ingestion processes, ETL/ELT pipelines, transformations, data platforms, semantic layers, and downstream products to identify root causes. Assess the scope and business impact of data issues, document findings and recommendations, and assign accountability to the appropriate resolution teams. Coordinate remediation with data owners, business stewards, portfolio owners, engineers, platform teams, and system owners; track progress and escalate high-impact or recurring issues when necessary. Validate implemented fixes, confirm closure evidence, and ensure corrective actions do not create unintended downstream impacts. Support the onboarding of data products and critical data elements into enterprise data quality and observability capabilities. Translate business expectations into measurable data quality rules, monitoring thresholds, alerts, and controls, helping reduce false positives. Develop and maintain dashboards and scorecards tracking data health, issue aging, recurrence, monitoring coverage, and remediation performance. Identify opportunities to prevent recurring defects by improving upstream controls, pipelines, data contracts, source processes, documentation, and operating procedures. Contribute to data product certification, maturity assessments, metadata management, lineage validation, governance standards, stewardship workflows, and technical runbooks. Requirements At least 3 years of experience in technical data stewardship, data quality, data management, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related field. Strong SQL skills, including hands-on experience with data profiling, reconciliation, and troubleshooting. Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across source systems, data transformations, pipelines, platforms, and downstream consumption layers. Experience defining or implementing data quality rules across dimensions such as accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, and timeliness. Familiarity with data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, or data observability platforms. Experience with Databricks and cloud-based data platforms. Knowledge of Collibra Data Quality & Observability and the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform. Familiarity with tools such as dbt, Informatica, Monte Carlo, Soda, Great Expectations, or comparable data quality and observability solutions. Experience with metadata management, data lineage, data catalogs, and data product certification. Familiarity with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or similar tools for managing investigation and remediation workflows. Ability to translate business expectations into measurable technical controls and communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to coordinate resolution across multiple teams and drive progress without direct authority. Experience supporting data product or federated data governance models and working in complex, global, matrixed organizations is an advantage. human_review.description: Accountabilities:: As Demand Planner, you will own forecast accuracy and the assumptions behind your assigned portfolio. You will combine statistical analysis, commercial insights, and scenario planning to anticipate changes in demand, communicate risks and opportunities, and support the organization's monthly consensus and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs. Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices. Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments. Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth. Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans. Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions. Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances. Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior. Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams. Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes.
